title: Fidelity invests in xAI's Series E

sources.quote: Investors participating in the round include Valor Equity Partners, Stepstone Group, Fidelity Management & Research Company, Qatar Investment Authority, MGX and Baron Capital Group, amongst other key partners.

explain: Fidelity's funds took part in xAI's $20 billion Series E (counted in full on the Valor record); the amount was not disclosed.
